# Slice of Heaven Vintage Cakes

> Home-based bakery in Tampa, Florida making hand-piped vintage (Lambeth-style) buttercream cakes: heart-shaped, round and two-tier. Cakes are made for pickup; customers come from across Tampa Bay, including St. Petersburg and Clearwater.

## Key facts
- Cakes start at $65 for a 6-inch, 2-layer cake. Sizes: 6, 8 and 10 inch; 2 to 4 layers. Tiered cakes are priced by quote.
- Included flavors: vanilla, chocolate, red velvet, carrot, confetti, lemon. Vanilla buttercream filling and standard writing are included.
- Orders are taken up to 1.5 months before the pickup date and at least 3 days out.
- Quotes are answered within 24 to 48 hours. Once a quote is received, a 50% non-refundable deposit secures the date; the balance is due 24 hours before pickup.
- Delivery is very limited, not guaranteed, and has a mileage fee.
